Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenHydrogenRecycleThroughputBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenHydrogenRecycleThroughputBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenHydrogenRecycleThroughputBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable rate receipt for a coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating recycle balance.

This class scales a qualified basis receipt to kg/h and kmol/h. Internal recycle is reported separately and is excluded from the external mass balance.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1
